tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gcod kyi zin bris gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dang yum chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ gcod skal ldan thar lam stan thog gcig tu nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ dang por gcod kyi mtshan don shes dgos te/ slob dpon ār+ya de ba'i rgya gzhung las/ nyon mongs bdud bzhi 'joms pa dang*// bdag 'dzin rtsad nas gcod pa dang*// rtag mtha' bsgom pa'i gol sa dang*// gcod pa'i snyems thag gcod pa dang*// 'bras bu'i re dogs sel ba dang*// nges pa'i phyir na gcod ces bya// zhes pas/ de ltar nyams su len pa la/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes dang rnam pa gsum las/ sngon 'gro la zil gnon dmigs pa skor gsum las bdag zil gyis gnon pa dang*/ lha 'dre zil gyis gnon pa dang*/ gnas zil gyis gnon pa gsum las/ dang po bdag zil gyis gnon pa/ rang nyid khros mar bskyed pa'i sku gsung thugs dang*/ ba spu'i bu ga nas khros ma dpag tu med pa 'phros/ lha 'dre zil gyis non pas de'i 'od zer gyi lha 'dre thams cad bkug ste/ rdzi bos ra lug ded pa ltar ded nas gnas gang du dmigs pa'i yul der bskyal/ gnas der thams cad 'dus pa'i mthar khros ma'i ra bas bskor nas/ rang nyid phaṭ ces 'khrabs pas rang gi ba spu'i bu gar khros mas gtams pa rnams dang ra ba'i khros ma rnams phaṭ ces thams cad 'khrabs pas gnas zil gyis gnon par bsgom mo// de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya ste/ yang ār+ya de ba'i zhal nas/ chos nyid ngang nas skyabs 'gro dang*// sems bskyed smon lam btab par bya// zhes pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge dang*/ rin po che dang pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang la gcod yul brgyud pa'i bla ma sogs bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog chos dkon mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad bzhugs par bsams la/ yan lag bdun pa bya ste/ na mo gnyan sa 'dir gnas dang 'dir 'dus kyi lha 'dre tsho/

skal ldan bdag la cho 'phrul ston pa'i gnas gdon dang lus gdon/ 'gro ba ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ ma mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ lab kyi sgrol mar skyabs su mchi// rang rig ye shes ston mdzad pa'i// bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi// dngos grub sbyin par mdzad pa yi// yi dam rnams la skyabs su mchi// spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs pa yi// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// zhi gyur 'dod chags bral ba yi// dam chos rnams la skyabs su mchi// gang la phul na don che ba'i// dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi// gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang rab tu mdzes// 'jam dpal dbyangs la skyabs su mchi// snying rjes yongs su rgyud gang ba'i// spyan ras gzigs la skyabs su mchi// mthu stobs kun gyi gdug pa 'joms// rdo rje 'dzin la skyabs su mchi// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// khyed rnams la ni skyabs su mchi// khyed rnams la ni rten 'cha' yi// khyed rnams la ni phyag 'tshal lo// khyed rnams la ni mchod pa 'bul// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// dge de byang chub chen por bsngo// bkra shis sems ngo rtogs par shog /mi rtag rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// 'chi ba rjes su dran par byin gyis rlobs// bdag 'dzin rtsad nas chod par byin gyis rlobs// gnyan sa ri khrod 'grim par byin gyis rlobs// phung po gzan du skyur bar byin gyis rlobs// nyon mongs dug lnga zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// nyag gcig rtsad nas chod par byin gyis rlobs// byams dang snying rje 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// lha 'dre'i 'gro don nus par byin gyis rlobs// gcod yul mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs// ces brjod la tshogs rten rang la stim pa'i ngang nas lta thog tu 'jog

de nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs tshad med pa bzhi rgyud dang 'dres pa lan gsum bsgom/ de nas yang skyabs yul sngar ltar sgom gyin yan lag bdun pa phul nas gsol 'debs byed pa ni/ gcod yul spyi'i brgyud pa ni/ spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng nas// rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// bcom ldan shākya thub pa la gsol ba 'debs// ma pham mgon po la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal sras thogs med la gsol ba 'debs// slob dpon dbyig gnyen la gsol ba 'debs// ār+ya de ba la gsol ba 'debs// dam pa sangs rgyas la gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// ma cig lab sgron ma la gsol ba 'debs// rtsi ston dar ma la gsol ba 'debs// glang lung pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs// snyal pa skal ldan la gsol ba 'debs// gru pa dpal 'bar la gsol ba 'debs// shākya bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas ras pa la gsol ba 'debs// rin chen gzhon nu la gsol ba 'debs// sgro ston chen po la gsol ba 'debs// rin chen 'od zer la gsol ba 'debs// chos kyi dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs// zhen med ras pa la gsol ba 'debs// gzhon nu bzang po la gsol ba 'debs// ye shes 'od zer la gsol 'debs// shes rab seng ge la gsol 'debs// blo gsal ri khrod la gsol ba 'debs// 'khrul zhig tshangs pa'i rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs// 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan rin chen la gsol 'debs// bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// ma cig la gsol ba 'debs// yum chen mos byin gyis rlobs/ thabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ shākya thub pa la gsol ba 'debs// 'jam dbyangs la gsol ba 'debs// ār+ya de ba la gsol ba 'debs// dam pa sangs rgyas la gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// ma cig lab sgron la gsol ba 'debs// khu sgom chos seng gsol ba 'debs// dol pa zang thal la gsol ba 'debs// rgya nag gcer bu la gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas rab ston la gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas dge slong la gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas ras pa la gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas ston pa la gsol ba 'debs// mkhas grub chos rje la gsol ba 'debs// chos rje gser gling pa la gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje dpal ba la gsol ba 'debs// chos dpal shes rab la gsol ba 'debs// blo gsal ri khrod la gsol ba 'debs// 'khrul zhig tshangs pa'i rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs// 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan rin chen la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// ma cig la gsol ba 'debs// yum chen mos byin gyis rlobs/

shes rab kyi brgyud pa ni/ yum chen mo la gsol ba 'debs// sgrol ma la gsol ba 'debs// su ka sid+dhi la gsol ba 'debs// dam pa sangs rgyas la gsol ba 'debs// ma cig la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal ba don grub la gsol ba 'debs// dam pa dbus pa la gsol ba 'debs// gzhon nu ye shes la gsol ba 'debs// mi bskyod rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas ston pa la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro mgon lung phran pa la gsol ba 'debs// gdan gcig pa chen po gsol ba 'debs// bsam gtan dar la gsol ba 'debs// mi nyag rin rgyal ba la gsol ba 'debs// blo gsal ri khrod pa la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan rin chen la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// ma cig la gsol ba 'debs// yum chen mos byin gyis rlobs// gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs// byin rlabs thugs kyi dkyil nas zhu// gsol ba 'ar ma 'ur mar 'debs// byin rlabs ban ma bun mar zhu// mi rtag rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// sogs gong bzhin 'dod don du gsol ba 'debs/ de nas tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par bsgom pa'i ngang nas/ rang gi rnam shes phaṭ ces brjod nas nam mkhar 'phangs te a dkar po zhig tu gyur par bsgom/ de la dmigs nas a brgya rtsa bgrangs pas/ a las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas/ rang gi tshangs bug tu bab pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas sdig sgrib dud khu'i rnam par dag bdud rtsis gang ba dang phaṭ ces a la bstim/ yang phaṭ ces a yang mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas/ rgya skyed khyab gdal chen por bzhag de'i ngang nas yang mdun gyi nam mkhar tshogs rten skyabs yul ltar bzhugs par bsgoms nas/ ngag tu phaṭ ces brjod pas/ lpags pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ phaṭ ces pas sha me tog gi tshom bu/ phaṭ ces pas khrag spos chu'i chag chag

phaṭ ces pas byang khog ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ phaṭ ces pas mgo rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang*/ phaṭ ces pas mig gnyis nyi ma dang zla ba/ phaṭ ces pas snying yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ phaṭ ces pas yan lag bzhi gling bzhi/ phaṭ ces pas nying lag bzhi gling phran bzhi/ phaṭ ces brjod pas rin po che'i ri bo/ dpag bsam gyi shing*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog sogs ma tshang ba med pa'i zhing khams rnam par dag pa 'di dang*/ rang gi lus longs spyod/ kha rje dbang thang*/ mthu dang nus pa/ rdzas yo byad/ yul ris rgyal khams dang bcas pa 'di nyid bla ma yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rin chen maṇ+ḍal gser g.yus brgyan pa 'di// bla ma kun khyab chos kyi sku la 'bul// rang lus maṇ+ḍal dbang pos brgyan pa 'di// bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la 'bul// sems nyid maṇ+ḍal rig pas brgyan pa 'di// bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la 'bul// sku gsum dbyer med maṇ+ḍal la// 'khor 'das dbyer med tshom bu bkod// sku bzhi'i bdag nyid chos kyi rje la 'bul// zhes brjod de'i ngang nas byang chub kyi sems sbyong bar byed pa'i dmigs pa la gtong len gnyis po spel mar byed/ de nyid rlung gi rta la skyon ces pa dang*/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ bdag la de dag sdig smin zhing*// bdag bde ma lus de smin shog /ces pa ltar rang gi rlung phyir 'bud pa dang sdongs nas/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sems can rnams la sbyin pa'i dmigs pa byas/ ngag tu bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag sems can rnams la sbyin pa'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral te myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par gyur cig bsam pa dang*/

de nas rdos bcas kyi lus po sa la 'bebs pa/ rten med kyi rig pa nam mkha' la 'phang zhes pas/ dang por rang lus 'di sa gzhi'i steng du chab ste phab la baṃ ro 'jigs su rung ba zhig tu gyur la/ de yang rgya je che je che la song bas kun khyab par bsgoms la rang gi ngag tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ khol lud/ ma dag pa'i tshogs rnams sa 'og tu bab/ dag pa'i tshogs rnams nam mkha' khengs par gyur nas/ 'khor 'das kyi 'gron rnams kyis gsol bas mnyes shing tshim par bsgoms la rten med kyi rig pa 'di phaṭ ces nam mkhar 'phangs nas/ nam mkhas gar khyab rig pas khyab/ rgya skyed khyab gdal chen por bzhag bem rig phral dbyings rig bsres la/ dbyings dang rig pa 'dres pa la// sgom phyag rgya chen po mi zer ram// zhes pa'i don no// de nas dngos gzhi nyams su len pa la pha dam pa la brten nas/ gcod kyi 'pho ba sbyong ba dang*/ dkar 'gyed kyi sgo nas tshogs gsog khros ma nag mo la brten nas gcod kyi 'pho ba sbyong ba dang*/ dmar 'gyed la brten nas tshogs gsog ma cig lab sgron la brten nas gcod kyi 'pho ba sbyong ba dang sna tshogs 'gyed kyi sgo nas tshogs gsog pa'o// de la dang por mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge brgyad dang*/ pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du pha dam pa sku mdog smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ dbu skra nag la li ba/ spyan rtsa dmar la zlum pa/ shangs mtho la nyag pa/ phyag g.yas seng ldeng gi ḍa ma ru 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon rten 'brel gyi gal ta brla g.yon pa'i steng du bsnams pa/ sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ ras sham dkar po gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo krung gi khri snyan sa le'i lpags pa mgo dang sder bzhi ma nyams pa'i steng du bzhugs te/ thugs chos nyid kyi rol pas bdag la byin gyis rlob bzhin par bzhugs par bsgoms la/ rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo phaṭ ces brjod nas dam pa'i thugs kar 'phangs la bstim pas/

dam pa'i zhal nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gsungs pas rang lus bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa zhig tu gyur nas/ khol lud pa'i ma dag pa'i dri ma rnams sa 'og tu babs/ dwangs ma rnams lud de nam mkhar lud cing gang bas 'khor 'das khyab par gyur nas/ 'gron thams cad la phul zhing so sor sbyin pas mnyes shing tshim par bsams la ngag tu/ bdag gi lus bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i 'gron rnams la 'bul lo// bzhes nas kyang tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis byang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig ces brjod do// khros ma nag mo la brten te bsgom pa ni rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge dang pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du baṃ pho mo bsnol ba'i steng du/ khros ma nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog nag mo 'od 'phro ba/ rtsa zhal khro zhal spyan gsum me ltar 'bar ba/ zhal bgrad pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor gtsug gyen du brdzes shing zar bu rgyab kyi rting pa'i bar du sleb pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu la brgyan zhing*/ thod rlon lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi do shal 'phyang ba/ sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan zhing*/ zhabs g.yas skum g.yon brkyang bas baṃ pho mo mnan pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom pa'i thugs kar sems gtad la/ ngag tu phaṭ ces brjod pas rang gi rnam shes tshangs bug nas bton te/ thugs kar 'phangs la bstim pas khros ma'i phyag g.yas kyi gri gug gis rang gi dpral ba nas bshags la pags pas sa gzhi khyab par bting ba'i steng du/ lhu bcu gnyis mgo dang bcu gsum/ dbang po rnam pa lnga/ don snying rnam pa lnga/ nang khrol rnam pa lnga/ sha'i ri/ khrag gi rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i gram khrod/ klad pa klad rgya/ rkang dang zhag pags pa dang*/ bkrag dang*/ dbugs dang srog la sogs dmar gyi rigs ma tshang ba med pa zhig tu gyur par bsgoms la/

'khor 'das kyi 'gron dang*/ khyad par du'ang bdag dang bdag cag thams cad kyi tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta la thug gi bar du/ bsad pa srog gi lan chags/ rgyag rdung na tsha'i lan chags/ rku 'phrog nor gyi lan chags/ rta glang po 'bru'i bang mdzod/ mdor na 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di/ gnod byed thams cad la 'bul lo// lan chags bu lon 'khor/ sha 'khon byang*/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig ces dang ngag tu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te// skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrug pa las// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /ces so// ma cig la brten nas bsgom pa ni/ yang rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du/ ma cig lab kyi sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma zhal dkar zhing 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan dang*/ zar bu rgyab tu grol ba/ phyag g.yas gser gyi ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon dngul dkar gyi dril bu kha nang du bstan nas bsnyen pa'i tshul du sgrog pa sku la dar dkar po'i na bza' gsol ba rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas baṃ pho mo bsnol ba'i steng du/ gar stabs ling nge bzhugs par bsgoms pa'i thugs kar dmigs pa gtad nas/ ngag tu/ phaṭ ces brjod pas rang gi rnam shes tshangs bug nas bton te/ ma cig gi thugs kar bstim pas ma cig gi zhal nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gsungs pas/ rang lus 'di yid bzhin gyi nor bu dgos 'dod 'byung ba dang*/ yang na dpag bsam gyi sdong po dgos 'dod 'byung ba dang*/ nam mkha' mdzod du gyur nas dgos 'dod thams cad ma tshang ba med par bsams la/ thog mar sbyin pa ni/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi smon lam las/ bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon// lam zhugs rnams kyi ded dpon dang*// bsgral 'dod rnams kyi gru dang dang ni// rdzings dang zam pa nyid du 'gyur// gling don gnyer la gling dag dang*// gnas mal 'dod la gnas mal dang*// bdag ni lus can bran 'dod pa// kun gyi bran du 'gyur bar shog

/yid bzhin nor bu bum pa bzang*// rig sngags grub dang sman chen dang*// dpag bsam gyi ni shing dag dang*// lus can kun gyi 'dod 'jor gyur// sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang*// nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par ni// sems can dpag tu med pa yi// rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i gzhir yang shog /ces pas/ dang por byin rlabs bla ma'i 'gron la/ phyi'i mchod pa mchod yon dang zhabs bsil la sogs dngos su bshams pa dang*/ yid kyis sprul pa rnams 'bul/ nang gi mchod pa gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyi bde stong gi mchod pa dpag tu med par bsam/ gsang ba'i mchod pa mchod bya mchod byed mi dmigs pa bla na med pa don gyi mchod pas mchod par bsam/ gzhan yang gang 'tshal kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin sprul nas 'bul bar bsam/ dngos grub 'byung ba yi dam 'gron la yang sku yi rgyal mtshan sogs mchod par bsam/ dkon mchog sri zhu'i 'gron la/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog la na bza' dang bzhugs gdan la sogs kyis mchod/ chos dkon mchog la po ti glegs bam/ glegs thag na bza' sogs kyis mchod par bsam/ dge 'dun dkon mchog la na bza' bzhugs gdan la sogs pas mchod/ mgon po yon tan gyi 'gron la/ sku rgyal mtshan phyag mtshan rten rdzas la sogs pas mchod/ 'gro drug snying rje'i 'gron la/ tsha dmyal la grang ba dang*/ grang dmyal la dro ba dang*/ yi dwags la zas skom/ dud 'gro la zas gos/ lha la 'dod yon/ lha ma yin la go mtshon/ mi la yid la 'dod pa rnams 'bad med du sbyin par bsam/ gnod byed lan chags kyi 'gron rnams la/ lan chags bu lon sha 'khon thams cad 'jal bar bsams nas/ gnod sems zhi nas byams dang snying rje'i bsam pa skyes par bsam zhing ngag tu/ smon lam 'di skad brjod do// bdag gi lus dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gter chen por gyur pa 'di/ byin rlabs bla ma'i 'gron/ dngos grub 'byung ba yi dam gyi 'gron/

dkon mchog sri zhu'i 'gron/ mgon po yon tan gyi 'gron/ rigs drug snying rje'i 'gron/ gnod byed lan chags kyi 'gron rnams la 'bul lo/ phul ba la brten nas mnyes shing tshim nas/ bka' brgyud bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs gyur cig rgyal ba rnams dang thugs yid 'dres gyur cig dkon mchog mchod pas mnyes gyur cig dam can thugs dam skong gyur cig rigs drug 'dod pa tshim gyur cig gnod byed lan chags 'khor gyur cig 'gro ba ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis dag nas/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po thob par gyur cig ces so// da ni rjes kyi dmigs pa rgyun khyer gsum la/ ngag tu phaṭ ces brjod la/ rang gi rnam shes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur nas/ tshangs bug nas bton te nam mkhar bzhugs pas phyag g.yas kyis gri gug des rang gi thod pa breg nas/ mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du btsugs/ lus thams cad gtub nas btab/ zhal nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gsungs pas kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsir bsams la/ 'khor 'das 'gron rnams gnas so so nas spyan drangs nas/ gsol bas mnyes par bsgom la/ yang thams cad phaṭ ces pas mi dmigs par gyur nas/ lta thog tu 'jog ku sā li'i tshogs sogs yin no// de nas yang rang la mthu dang byed kha gtong ba'i sbad 'dre sbod gtong*/ byad ma lha srung rnams rang khros mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis rang dbang med par bkug la/ 'dir bzhugs bdag gi lus dang longs spyod rdzas dang yo byad/ gnas khang dang bcas pa 'bul bas 'dir rgyun du bzhugs byas la ngag tu phaṭ ces pas rang gi rnam shes bton nas nam mkhar 'phangs/ rgya skyed khyab gdal chen por bzhag gnod byed tsho rang ci byed bgyis snyam pa dang lta thog tu bzhag go// rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer las/

gnod byed thams cad bkug nas mdun du bzhugs par bsgoms nas/ phaṭ byas pas/ rang gi lus 'di zhig snying rgyal ba shākya thub par gyur/ lus thams cad 'khor byang sems dang nyan rang du gyur/ seng ge'i khri rgya chen po pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du bzhugs pa/ byang chub kyi shing la rgyab rten nas bzhugs par bsams nas/ gnod byed thams cad 'gyod pa skyes nas chos zhus par bsam/ chos ni chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung sogs smon lam dang bsgrags nas shod/ de nas yang mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas bsngo ba dang bdag 'khor ma sogs byed do// de ltar dam pa'i chos thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam zab mo bdud kyi gcod yul 'di nyams su blangs pas/ gnas skabs su tshe ring zhing 'chi ba bslu ba snyan grags kyis sa steng khyab/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs shing*/ 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub thams cad thob/ 'jig rten las 'das pa mchog gi dngos grub sku bzhi rtags brgyad thob par 'gyur ro// bsam pa'i don 'grub dpal gyi yon tan ldan// ring du 'tsho zhing mchog la gzhol ba yi// 'di nyid dgos zhes yang yang skul ba'i ngor// kun dga'i ming can bdag gis phan sems kyi// 'bri gung 'og min zin bris nyid du bkod// de las byung dge ba gang mtshon des// 'gro rnams rang byung ye shes rtogs gyur nas// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i mig 'gyur nas// gnyis med ye shes rdo rje mchog thob shog /// mad+galaṃ/
